name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: B2B SaaS Account Manager | Onboarding to Renewal, Adoption & Revenue Retention
summary: B2B SaaS account manager who owns the customer from onboarding through renewal. Retained all but one of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye (~94%) by watching utilization data and stepping in before adoption gaps became churn. Held 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while onboarding 25+ clients a month at Wix, and ranked top three of 8 to 15 reps at Accelo while quota roughly doubled. Builds automated re-engagement for inactive customers, routes customer needs to Product, and runs the account on data in Salesforce and HubSpot.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the client relationship from onboarding through ongoing delivery for a portfolio of B2B service businesses, running discovery to surface goals and constraints.
Built automated re-engagement and reactivation workflows that bring inactive customers back, part of a 20+ workflow lifecycle system covering onboarding, nurture, and reviews.
Expand retainer scope with existing clients, identifying complementary services and writing the proposals and statements of work to close them.
Report results to business owners on a regular cadence with dashboards tracking pipeline, funnel progression, and ROI.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed ~3 multi-stakeholder client accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend each, peaking above $100K/month, as strategic lead across internal departments.
Delivered quarterly business reviews with ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion reporting, turning performance data into budget and growth recommendations.
Resolved client feedback promptly and held delivery quality consistent to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed a book of 15-20 reseller partners with deal sizes of ~$10K-$45K, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Onboarded partners and their end customers, guiding complex technical setup and configuration of reputation and marketing automation tools.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance data to find adoption gaps and intervene before they turned into churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, deepening engagement across health, home services, and retail verticals.
Routed structured customer feedback to Product and Engineering, linking field signals to roadmap decisions.

bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each, several exceeding $25K, for roughly $130K+ in total bookings.
Ran client accounts end to end, covering execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, and led the sales team.

bullets: Held 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while onboarding and launching 25+ clients per month.
